discussion.body: Build studies for the three villains, not clothes. Faces and forms match the existing FEAT-002 plates. Vortan: elderly Constium Forge-King, dwarf-king weight on old forge muscle, gray beard, short heavy. Velith: Bengenia Archon, taller and colder than Seris, no veil-crown in this pass. Nyxara: no human flesh; hollow cracked anatomy with ember core under the mantle. Locals: artifacts/Concept art/FEAT-002-vortan-build-study.jpg, FEAT-002-velith-build-study.jpg, FEAT-002-nyxara-form-study.jpg. Existing clothed/form plates stay.
